stages.title: STAGE A — Passive OSINT Framework
stages.subtitle: Certificate Level · Zero Active Probing · Safe & Legal Reconnaissance
stages.summary: Master foundational passive Open Source Intelligence. Collect, verify, and correlate publicly available information across search engines, archives, DNS/certificate registries, social platforms, and geospatial imagery without ever touching or alerting a target system.
outcomes: Explain and execute the passive OSINT cycle on authorized public targets.
Operate 10+ industry-standard passive OSINT tools independently and safely.
Map public infrastructure passively (domain -> passive subdomains -> CT logs -> IPs).
Verify digital images and public claims using reverse image search and metadata.
Maintain strict analyst OPSEC and adhere to legal and ethical boundaries.
Produce a structured passive OSINT investigation report with verifiable citations.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Foundations
phases.summary: Core intelligence concepts, the strict passive boundary, analyst OPSEC, and legal ethics.

modules.title: Module 1: What is OSINT
modules.summary: OSINT vs HUMINT/SIGINT/IMINT, open data sources, and the five-step intelligence cycle.

modules.title: Module 2: Passive vs Active Recon
modules.summary: Understanding zero-touch collection, third-party intermediaries, authorization, and Rules of Engagement.

modules.title: Module 3: OPSEC Fundamentals
modules.summary: Browser compartmentalization, VM isolation, VPN threat models, research accounts, and metadata hygiene.

modules.title: Module 4: Legal & Ethical Boundaries
modules.summary: Data protection laws (GDPR/CCPA concepts), Terms of Service, consent, proportionality, and 'hunt patterns not people'.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Technical Basics for Passive OSINT
phases.summary: Conceptual networking, search indexing mechanics, file metadata/hashes, and essential Linux CLI utilities.

modules.title: Module 5: How the Internet Works
modules.summary: Conceptual walkthrough of IPv4/IPv6, ASN routing, DNS record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME), HTTP headers, and TLS.

modules.title: Module 6: Browser & Search Engine Mechanics
modules.summary: Web crawlers, robots.txt, sitemaps, indexing pipelines, DOM inspection, and cached snapshots.

modules.title: Module 7: Data Types & Metadata
modules.summary: File signatures (magic bytes), cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA-256), EXIF/XMP tags, PDF metadata, and UTC timestamps.

modules.title: Module 8: Linux Command Line Basics
modules.summary: Using grep, awk, sort, uniq, curl, whois, dig, file, and sha256sum cleanly for local OSINT text processing.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Search & Public Records
phases.summary: Precision search operators across global engines, historical web archives, public registries, and CT logs.

modules.title: Module 9: Search Operators & Dorking
modules.summary: Boolean logic and precision operators (site:, filetype:, intitle:, inurl:) across Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and Yandex.

modules.title: Module 10: Web Archives & Cached Data
modules.summary: Recovering historical web pages and CDX API timelines via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine and archive.today.

modules.title: Module 11: Public Records & Registries
modules.summary: ICANN RDAP/WHOIS lookups, regional internet registries (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC), patent/trademark filings, and public gazettes.

modules.title: Module 12: Certificate Transparency Logs
modules.summary: How TLS Certificate Authorities publish append-only CT logs and how to discover subdomains passively via crt.sh.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Passive Infrastructure & Social Recon
phases.summary: Zero-touch infrastructure correlation, internet-wide scan index reading, public profile pivoting, and breach hygiene.

modules.title: Module 13: Passive DNS & Subdomain Enumeration
modules.summary: Historical DNS resolution sensors, passive subdomain aggregators, ASN mapping, and strictly avoiding DNS brute-forcing.

modules.title: Module 14: Shodan/Censys/FOFA Basics
modules.summary: Querying pre-indexed internet banner repositories (Shodan, Censys) safely without launching any packets at targets.

modules.title: Module 15: Social Media OSINT (SOCMINT)
modules.summary: Username reuse correlation, public bio/handle pivoting, platform ID persistence, and verification against impersonators.

modules.title: Module 16: Email & Breach Data Concepts
modules.summary: Corporate email naming conventions, MX/SPF/DMARC record reading, k-anonymity breach notification services (HIBP), and strict legal rules.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Visual & Geo Passive OSINT
phases.summary: Reverse image workflows, synthetic media detection, landmark geolocation, and solar chronolocation.

modules.title: Module 17: Reverse Image Search
modules.summary: Comparative strengths of Google Lens, Yandex Images, TinEye, and Bing Visual Search, plus keyframe cropping techniques.

modules.title: Module 18: Image Verification & Metadata
modules.summary: Metadata stripping on social networks, Error Level Analysis caveats, AI/deepfake visual artifacts, and provenance standards (C2PA).

modules.title: Module 19: Geolocation Basics
modules.summary: Extracting road signage, utility poles, vegetation, terrain, and architectural clues using OpenStreetMap Overpass Turbo and satellite imagery.

modules.title: Module 20: Chronolocation & Timeline Building
modules.summary: Estimating capture time via shadow azimuth (SunCalc), historical weather archives, flight/maritime public tracks, and structured event timelines.

stages.title: STAGE B — Advanced Investigation (Threat Intel & SOC)
stages.subtitle: Locked Until Stage A Passive OSINT Certificate Earned
stages.summary: Apply certified passive OSINT Tradecraft to defensive cybersecurity operations: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), MITRE ATT&CK reconnaissance mapping, SOC L1 alert enrichment, phishing infrastructure tracing, corporate due diligence, and Admiralty-graded analytic reporting.
outcomes: Apply OSINT to Cyber Threat Intelligence (IOC handling, Pyramid of Pain, MITRE ATT&CK mapping).
Enrich SOC L1 alerts and incident response workflows with passive external context.
Conduct advanced corporate beneficial-ownership and ethical people investigations.
Produce decision-ready intelligence reports using Structured Analytic Techniques and Admiralty grading.

phases.title: Phase 6 — Threat Intelligence
phases.summary: Strategic, operational, and tactical CTI models, MITRE ATT&CK Recon mapping, and safe IOC handling.

modules.title: Module 21: CTI Fundamentals
modules.summary: Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Adversary TTPs, David Bianco's Pyramid of Pain, Diamond Model, and Cyber Kill Chain.

modules.title: Module 22: MITRE ATT&CK Recon Mapping
modules.summary: Mapping adversary pre-compromise reconnaissance (TA0043: T1589-T1598) to defensive visibility and deception.

modules.title: Module 23: Threat Feeds & Safe IOC Handling
modules.summary: Defanging malicious URLs/IPs, Traffic Light Protocol (TLP 2.0), STIX 2.1 / TAXII 2.1, MISP/OpenCTI, and responsible disclosure.

phases.title: Phase 7 — SOC & Incident Response
phases.summary: Alert triage enrichment, phishing & C2 infrastructure pivoting, and vulnerability exposure prioritization.

modules.title: Module 24: SOC Fundamentals
modules.summary: SOC tier workflows, SIEM alert triage, log correlation basics, false-positive reduction, and external OSINT enrichment.

modules.title: Module 25: OSINT in Incident Response
modules.summary: Tracing phishing domains, TLS JARM/JA3 concepts, sandboxed URL scanners (urlscan.io), and pivoting across attacker ASN clusters.

modules.title: Module 26: Vulnerability Context & Exposure Management
modules.summary: Combining NVD CVEs, CVSS, EPSS, and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) with passive asset exposure data.

phases.title: Phase 8 — Advanced Investigation
phases.summary: Corporate due diligence, ethical verification limits, dark web conceptual awareness, and professional analytic trade-craft.

modules.title: Module 27: Corporate & Business OSINT
modules.summary: Corporate registries (SEC EDGAR, Companies House, OpenCorporates), LEI codes (GLEIF), sanctions screening, and supply-chain mapping.

modules.title: Module 28: People OSINT Advanced
modules.summary: Public-interest attribution standards, conflict-of-interest checks, anti-doxxing safeguards, and structured source corroboration.

modules.title: Module 29: Dark Web Awareness (Concepts Only)
modules.summary: Conceptual distinction between Clear, Deep, and Dark Web, onion routing architecture, ransomware leak site monitoring via clearnet CTI feeds, and strict legal boundaries (zero access instructions).

modules.title: Module 30: Professional Reporting & Analysis
modules.summary: Structured Analytic Techniques (Analysis of Competing Hypotheses), cognitive biases, Words of Estimative Probability, BLUF writing, and the Admiralty Code.
